name: Garrett Buttrey
current_role: Deputy Chief of Staff, U.S. Department of Labor (since May 2026)
summary: Garrett Buttrey is a deputy chief of staff in the Labor Department’s Office of the Secretary, named on May 1, 2026. He joined the administration in 2025 as chief of staff and senior policy adviser of the department’s Wage and Hour Division, after serving as senior policy counsel and then chief counsel of the Senate Health, Education, Labor and Pensions Committee.
